what: br-bbki.24 (owner playtest 2026-10-17: 'it was easiest to just keep the throttle pinned') on the Feel Lab's canyon leap: a Cruz Missile takes the kicker flat out at 22 m/s and never lifts: the throttle stays pinned through the lip and the whole flight. It is no longer latched at takeoff, so it keeps raising the nose and over-rotates: it lands worse than the neutral run (air-pitch-neutral, OK) and the feathered one (air-pitch-down, clean).
